wins: Demonstrated strong reconnaissance by identifying three live hosts and a vulnerable service, earning 57.5 reward despite episode failure (ep001_step05)
Maintained persistent situational awareness with 15 mentor calls, enabling rapid pivots when initial footholds were blocked (ep001_step02)
fails: Unable to obtain success condition due to repeated post-exploitation privilege escalation failures on primary target (ep001_step18)
Missed time-critical initial exploit window by delaying script-based enumeration until after service patching activity (ep001_step11)
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was effective and highlighted exploitable services, but follow-through on privilege escalation and timing needs refinement to convert high reward into success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed immediately after gaining shell access, indicating missing kernel exploit or mis-tuned payload.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial TCP scan detects SSH banner with uncommon version string
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap scripting (sshv1, ssh-hostkey) and capture banner to catalog services and identify potential vulnerabilities

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH login yields low-privilege shell and sudo rights exist without password
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudoers with sudo -l, search for misconfigured commands, and prepare payload for execution with available privileges

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration reveals outdated HTTP server with known CVE
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to exploit sequence referencing verified module, capture response artifacts, and prioritize time-based actions before patch window closes

memory_ops.reason: High promise for privilege escalation once structured enumeration yields sudo opportunities

next_experiments.title: Exploit timing refinement
next_experiments.description: Automate immediate post-scan exploit attempts on identified services to avoid patch remediation windows and capture foothold earlier.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation payload validation
next_experiments.description: Test multiple kernel/userland escalation payloads in sandbox to determine reliable vector matching the target's environment before live deployment.

next_experiments.title: Sudo enumeration automation
next_experiments.description: Develop a scripted workflow that captures sudoers output and cross-references with known misconfigurations to reduce manual oversight.
